best-api.prompt: A row of glowing power sockets on a wall, each plugged with a different colored cable leading to a small robot, with price tags hanging from the cables.

best-chat.prompt: A smartphone on a café table with several colorful chat bubbles rising out of its screen, each bubble a slightly different shape, a coffee cup beside it.

best-coding.prompt: A programmer's desk at night, seen from behind, with a keyboard and a small friendly robot sitting on the monitor helping, code shown only as abstract colored lines.

best-image-generation.prompt: A paintbrush and a camera lens side by side producing a stream of colorful picture frames that fly out into the air.

best-local-llm.prompt: A home desktop computer tower on a wooden desk with a small glowing brain inside its glass side panel, a plant and a lamp beside it, cozy home office.

best-marketing.prompt: A megaphone, a shopping cart and a rising chart arranged around a small robot assistant sitting at a marketing team's table.

best-research.prompt: A stack of open books and printed reports on a library table with a large magnifying glass and a glowing laptop in the soft background.

best-slides.prompt: A stack of presentation slides fanning out of a laptop like a deck of playing cards, each card showing simple colorful charts without any text.

best-text-to-speech.prompt: An open book with a sound wave rising from its pages and turning into a friendly speaker, soft gradient background.

best-transcription.prompt: A meeting table with a small microphone in the center and a long ribbon of paper printing out of a laptop, covered in abstract lines, anonymous people blurred around.

best-translation.prompt: Two speech bubbles of different colors connected by a small bridge, with tiny people crossing the bridge from one bubble to the other.

best-video-generation.prompt: A film clapperboard on a desk with a small movie screen floating above it showing a cinematic sunset scene being generated, film reels nearby.

best-writing.prompt: A fountain pen writing on paper while a small robot holds the next sheet ready and another robot checks the finished pages.
